ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to <5% of the surface area, primarily localized at the distal tips and scattered point-source reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white/light-grey clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips (coordinate extremes). Minor localized high-intensity pixel clusters are visible in the lower-central region near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 80 degrees; notch apex is sharp with high-contrast definition against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe (image-right) exhibits larger amplitude peaks and valleys (notching) compared to the more subtly serrated left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sloping trajectory; the trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, dense clusters of high-intensity, multi-tonal pixel groups (biological encrustations) at both distal lobe tips. Small, isolated circular white pixel clusters are present in the lower-left quadrant of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, short horizontal and diagonal high-intensity linear marks are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological growth/encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes, creating an irregular, jagged silhouette beyond the fluke's structural boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent white marking/notch located in the lower-center of the fluke surface, positioned vertically above the water line.
